verdict.rationale: A buyer comparing GPU infrastructure vendors could reasonably ask about on-prem or self-hosted deployment, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only Lambda-hosted services: On-Demand Cloud, 1-Click Clusters, and managed Kubernetes/Slurm. Private Cloud is a single-tenant cluster with low-level access, but it is still run by Lambda, so it is an adjacent offering rather than self-hosting the core product.
